scope: Provider-neutral invariants for consequential action execution. This profile defines observable behavior, not a claim that every production deployment satisfies the threat model.

invariants.name: proposal_is_not_authority
invariants.requirement: A proposal alone MUST NOT authorize execution. Execution requires a valid permit bound to the evaluated proposal and decision.

invariants.name: exact_action_binding
invariants.requirement: A permit MUST bind the exact action, destination, and parameters. Post-authorization mutation MUST be rejected before dispatch.

invariants.name: one_use_authority
invariants.requirement: A permit for a consequential action MUST be consumable at most once as a logical action authority.

invariants.name: unknown_is_not_success_or_failure
invariants.requirement: Ambiguous transport or incomplete provider evidence MUST remain OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until independent evidence resolves it.

invariants.name: independent_outcome_authority
invariants.requirement: Executor output MUST NOT be terminal outcome authority. Independently readable provider evidence determines reconciliation.

invariants.name: divergence_contains_authority
invariants.requirement: An independently observed effect that differs from the authorized action MUST be classified DIVERGENT_EFFECT and trigger containment for the affected campaign.

invariants.name: no_automatic_logical_retry
invariants.requirement: No reconciliation result, including failure or unknown, MUST automatically authorize a new logical action attempt.

invariants.name: separate_evidence_chains
invariants.requirement: Proposal, evidence, decision, and execution records MUST remain separately identifiable and independently chain-verifiable in the reference profile.

known_out_of_scope: human comprehension or legal sufficiency of approval
